test_title: PYST 16: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A solid cone has a height of 63 cm and a base radius of 16 cm. If the painting rate is ₹1.75/cm², what will be the total cost (in ₹) of painting the total surface area of the cone? Use pi = (22)/(7)
solution:
**Given:**

Height (h) = 63 cm

Base Radius (r) = 16 cm

Painting Rate = ₹1.75/cm²

**Formula used:**

Total Surface Area of Cone = pi r (r + l)

Where l is the slant height and l = sqrt{r² + h²}

**Calculation:**

l = sqrt{16² + 63²} 

l = sqrt{256 + 3969}

l = sqrt{4225}

l = 65 {cm}

Total Surface Area = pi r (r + l)

⇒ Total Surface Area = dfrac{22}{7} times 16 times (16 + 65)

⇒ Total Surface Area = dfrac{22}{7} times 16 times 81

⇒ Total Surface Area = 4073.14 cm2

Cost of Painting = Total Surface Area × Painting Rate

⇒ Cost of Painting = 4073.14 × 1.75

⇒ Cost of Painting = 7128

∴ The correct answer is option (4).
